tools.name: amaze_card_info
tools.description: Navigate to the Instarem Amaze multi-currency Mastercard page. Available for Singapore users only.

promotions.description: Navigate directly to current Amaze card promotions

tools.name: business_payments
tools.description: Navigate to the Instarem Business page for SME cross-border payment solutions, business cards, and supplier payments.

locale.description: Business locale (en-au, en-hk, en-id, en-in, en-my, en-sg, en-gb, en-us, en-eu)

tools.name: compare_rates
tools.description: Navigate to the Instarem rate comparison tool to compare exchange rates against Wise, Western Union, and other providers.

tools.name: find_ifsc_code
tools.description: Navigate to the Instarem IFSC code finder for Indian bank branches.

tools.name: find_swift_code
tools.description: Navigate to the Instarem SWIFT/BIC code finder to look up any bank's SWIFT or BIC code worldwide.

bank.description: Bank name to search for (e.g. HDFC Bank, Barclays, DBS)

tools.name: get_fx_rate
tools.description: Navigate to the Instarem currency conversion page to get a live exchange rate, fee, and estimated transfer time for a currency pair.

from.description: Source currency code (e.g. SGD, USD, GBP)

to.description: Destination currency code (e.g. INR, PHP, MXN)

locale.description: Sending country locale (e.g. en-sg, en-us, en-gb). Defaults to current page locale.

tools.name: help_centre
tools.description: Navigate to the Instarem help centre — consumer or business depending on current page context.

type.description: Which help centre to navigate to. Defaults to current page context.

videos.description: Navigate directly to the how-to videos section

tools.name: routing_number_lookup
tools.description: Navigate to the Instarem US bank routing number lookup tool.

bank.description: US bank name (e.g. Chase, Bank of America, Wells Fargo)

tools.name: send_money_to_country
tools.description: Navigate to the Instarem send money page for a specific destination country, showing fees, supported banks, and transfer limits.

country.description: Destination country slug in lowercase with hyphens (e.g. india, philippines, united-kingdom)

locale.description: Sending country locale (e.g. en-sg, en-us). Defaults to current page locale.

tools.name: sign_up
tools.description: Navigate to the Instarem sign-up page to create a new account.
